name: @hebcal/cities
description: Hebcal city database for candle-lighting times
author: Michael J. Radwin (https://github.com/mjradwin)

scripts.build:json2js: echo 'export default' > src/geo.js && cat src/geo.json >> src/geo.js
scripts.build:copy: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp src/cities.js dist/index.js && cp src/geo.js dist/geo.js
scripts.build: npm run build:json2js && npm run build:copy && npm run build:types
